address: Haarlemmerweg 778-938, Amsterdam (Westerpark West, across the Haarlemmertrekvaart from Haarlemmerweg ~512): "Pepper" (MVRDV, 2023), a dark grey-brown brick tower of 11 storeys with large square windows and dark closed box balconies projecting from scattered bays on every face, a glazed ground floor

walls.street: north front on the paved square off the Haarlemmerweg, with the glazed entrance bay

notes: Haarlemmerweg 778-938 (BAG pand 0363100012250971, built 2023, 749 m2, eaves 36.5 m, a 4.0 m ground storey and 10 upper storeys at 3.2 m). Evidence 2026-10-25: the Commons photo (Ceescamel, 2023-08-16, CC BY-SA 4.0, archived as source-data pand-reference-walls/0363100012250971/commons-2023-s.jpg, rectified to the south wall 21.79 x 36.46 m) is the measured front: 6 window columns on a 3.63 m pitch, square windows 0.55 of the bay and 0.68 of the storey, sill 0.18, and 17 box balconies placed by storey and bay (boxBalconies.storeyBays on walls[3]). Every municipal panorama of the tower after completion is summer foliage (2025-07-01: north 46 %, west 42 %, east 36-63 %); the 2017-2022 crops show the block it replaced. The likeness gate reads walls[3] as NO EVIDENCE only because 35 % of the crop is washed out (sky reflections in the glass); its other readings agree: wall #b2a8a0 vs #9d9692 (dL -0.07), glazing 0.489 vs 0.465, columns 6 vs 6, square vs square.

walls[0] north (surface 10), walls[1] west (1, 5) and walls[2] east (3, 4, 7): no usable photo. They carry the south front's brick, window shape and box balconies; that each face has boxes in a scattered pattern is seen in the 2025-07-01 panoramas (north crop, top storeys) and the Commons photo's east return, but their cells are INFERRED (a scattered pattern of the same density, 1-2 per storey). Installed with --allow-inferred=0 for the north front.

Kit addition: `boxBalconies` (src/canalRecall/blockBuilding/boxBalcony.ts, tested in buildingRecipe/boxBalcony.test.ts): a closed tray per listed (storey, bay) cell, a 0.24 m slab with a solid parapet on its front and both sides in the group's frame colour (deep 0.55 of the storey = 1.76 m, wide 0.85 of the bay, parapet 0.38 of the storey). Replaces the earlier glass-rail balconies, which the photo does not show. Still not expressible: the window columns shift from storey to storey on the photo (the kit keeps one bay grid per group); the thin metal rail on top of each parapet; boxes that wrap a corner. Facts: the OSM outline w1529423741 (a 9 m 'building' 5 m deep along the south front, a shop entry) was dropped from neighboursRD because it made the lower 9 m of the south wall a blank party wall, where the photo shows windows down to the glazed ground floor.

Palette: brick #8d8580 sits between the sunlit Commons reading (raw #b2a8a0, strong direct sun) and the overcast reading of the same brick, which the user describes as a dark tower; frame #23272b also colours the trays.
